grundmann.label: DERIVED (reanalysis of CITED Zenodo histogram; fit window ASSUMED, 3 variants reported)
grundmann.note: Symmetric (angle-independent) release delays are invisible to this interferometer (CITED note [19]).

ossiander.label: DERIVED from CITED Table 1 (theory errors ASSUMED 0)

malus.note: Crossed-polarizer purity bounds any extra term at Theta=90 deg (it also contains all imperfections, so it is an upper bound). A shape f(Theta) vanishing at 0, 45, 90 deg (e.g. Valentini-Varma Eq. 30) evades it; then only the ~1% Papaliolios bound applies.
malus.label: CITED

anisotropy.label: CITED
anisotropy.note: Bounds orientation dependence (lab frame vs fixed stars) of electron energy; for an add-on lock RATE the anisotropic part is bounded by the total rate bound (element 3 bands), since 0 <= Lambda(theta) <= 2 x mean for |a1|,|a2| <= 1.

threshold.note: R1: single 24.86 ueV quanta are individually registered (locked into a Fock state) and the response is linear in injected n = alpha^2 << 1, i.e. no amplitude gate down to sub-single-photon amplitudes; the QND readout locks the photon number without absorbing it, so an energy-transfer threshold > 0 is not required for a lock. R2: a gate simply hides the add-on below A_th, so A_th alone is unconstrained (degenerate with Lambda0).
threshold.label: CITED + DERIVED

gap.note: Between 20 mHz and 4.6e18 Hz only the single 8174 Hz cantilever line was verified this stage; other bounds exist in the literature (cold atoms, bulk heating, other cantilevers) but were not fetched, so they are not used.

amplitude.label: CITED + DERIVED
amplitude.note: Drive pulse area (0.325pi vs 0.675pi) and hence state amplitudes were alternated: no frequency change.

spread.mapping: ASSUMED O(1): a fraction f of electrons with a distinguishable openness label would escape the exclusion principle in K-shell capture, so f <~ beta^2/2
spread.note: If openness is set by context (extrinsic), particles stay identical and only the add-on strength bounds apply.

tau.universal_constant: not bounded by relative-timing data (cable-delay degenerate)
tau.label: DERIVED/CITED

hysteresis.derivation: DERIVED: absorption ~ A n, emission ~ E (1+n); steady state n/(1+n) = E/A. QM: E/A = exp(-x). With E/A = exp(-x)/(1+eta): n = 1/((1+eta) e^x - 1) = Bose-Einstein with mu = ln(1+eta).
hysteresis.assumption: ASSUMED: the asymmetry acts in the photon-number-changing processes that thermalised the CMB at z >~ 3e6 (CITED epoch), and is frequency independent; a frequency-dependent eta(x) is bounded by the 50 ppm-of-peak rms instead.
hysteresis.label: DERIVED + CITED

verdict.model: P = cos^2 Theta + delta f(Theta); birth delay = R cos(beta)/c + d1 cos(beta) + d2 P2; Lambda(theta)=Lambda0 g(theta)
verdict.qm_has: Malus cos^2, Fresnel, dipole patterns, photon-momentum retardation R cos(beta)/c (Grundmann measured it)
verdict.bound: generic |delta| < 1e-2 (1e-13 s after a lock); extra leak at 90 deg < 2.4e-10; extra angle-dependent birth delay beyond light-travel+nondipole |d1| < 485 zs per unit cos(beta) (95%; measured residual +235 +- 128 zs), |d2| < 102 zs; lab-orientation energy anisotropy < 1e-18
verdict.verdict: constrained but with real room in timing (|d1| < 2.0 x the light-travel term, residual 1.8 sigma); Malus 1e-2 generic, 2.4e-10 at 90 deg

verdict.qm_has: photoelectric frequency threshold (work function); none in amplitude
verdict.bound: R1: E_th <= 24.86 ueV per quantum; no amplitude gate down to n<<1 (linear eta=0.41); R2: unconstrained alone (hides effect)
verdict.verdict: R1 excluded above 2.5e-5 eV / any amplitude gate; R2 open but untestable alone
constrained in 3 bands; open across ~20 unverified decades (20 mHz-4.6e18 Hz except 8174 Hz)

verdict.verdict: excluded above 1.9e-14 of the transition energy

verdict.verdict: intrinsic excluded; extrinsic open (degenerate with strength)

verdict.bound: angle-dependent < 485 zs; channel-dependent < 1.5 as; jitter < 2.7 ps; plastic stage: Born holds to 1% at 1e-13 s
